scripts.check:packages: bun run check:publish-dry-run && bun run check:package-consumer
scripts.build:imagejob: bun run applik8s build examples/imagejob.ts --out-dir dist/applik8s
scripts.build:guestbook: bun run applik8s build examples/guestbook.ts --typekro --composition-name guestBookStack --out-dir dist/examples/guestbook
scripts.lint: biome lint . && node scripts/check-typecasts.mjs && node scripts/check-static-imports.mjs && node scripts/check-test-taxonomy.mjs && bun run check:runtime-contract && bun run check:docs-consistency && bun run check:release
scripts.test:v03:local: bun run test:v03:contracts && bun run test:v03:generated
scripts.test:v03:live: APPLIK8S_E2E=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_LIVE=1 bunx vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts packages/e2e/test/tenant-platform-live.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-modelstore-postgres.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-operation-target.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-scoped-listener.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:v03:live:orbstack: APPLIK8S_E2E=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_LIVE=1 APPLIK8S_E2E_CONTEXT=orbstack bunx vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts packages/e2e/test/tenant-platform-live.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-modelstore-postgres.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-operation-target.e2e.test.ts packages/e2e/test/typekro-scoped-listener.e2e.test.ts
scripts.check:v03:local: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:v03:local && bun run test:character
scripts.check:v03:prerelease: bun run check:v03:local && bun run test:v03:live
scripts.check:v03:prerelease:orbstack: bun run check:v03:local && bun run test:v03:live:orbstack
